import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_57/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_57/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)  # Source2_57_0: ['user_id', 'movie_id', 'rating']
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)  # Source2_57_1: ['movie_id', 'title']

# Operation 1: JOIN Source2_57_0 and Source2_57_1 on "movie_id"
df_joined = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="movie_id", how="inner")

# Operation 2: GROUP BY Source2_57_1.title, aggregations:
# count(Source2_57_0.user_id) as size, avg(Source2_57_0.rating) as mean
grouped = df_joined.groupby("title").agg(
    size=pd.NamedAgg(column="user_id", aggfunc="count"),
    mean=pd.NamedAgg(column="rating", aggfunc="mean")
).reset_index()

# Ensure correct data types as per target schema:
# 'title': string, 'size': integer, 'mean': float
grouped["title"] = grouped["title"].astype(str)
grouped["size"] = grouped["size"].astype(int)
grouped["mean"] = grouped["mean"].astype(float)

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_57/target_multisource.csv"
grouped.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_57/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_57/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join Source2_57_0 and Source2_57_1 on movie_id (inner join)
joined = pd.merge(source0, source1, on="movie_id", how="inner")

# Group by title, aggregate count of user_id as size and average of rating as mean
result = joined.groupby("title", as_index=False).agg(
    size=pd.NamedAgg(column="user_id", aggfunc="count"),
    mean=pd.NamedAgg(column="rating", aggfunc="mean")
)

# Write output with exact target schema column names
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_57/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
